model: thesis_food_insecurity_model (three-way blend: AUC-optimized combined LightGBM 40% + government-only logistic regression 40% + weak-trigger [climate/fish kill/OFW remittance] logistic regression 20%)

operating_spec.note: Three-way blend: AUC-optimized combined LightGBM (12 features, Eq. 5, 40%), a logistic regression on the 3 government features -- CPI deviation, unemployment, rice price -- (40%), and a dedicated logistic regression on the 3 weak/thin news-trigger categories -- climate stress, fish kill, OFW remittance -- (20%). The weak component was added because those 3 categories carried ~0% attribution in the two-way blend (their own standalone signal is weak: AUC 0.327 alone, worse than random); blending it in at 20% gives them real, non-zero influence on every forecast while the pooled walk-forward AUC across every real quarter moved from 0.910 to 0.913 (95 real predictions, 12 real negative cases) -- verified not to cost accuracy.
